typeIdent.description:
Indicates explicit sub-type of entry.  Composed of the concatenation of the typeKey of the instance's type and all
of its base type's typeIdent

id.description:
A unique identifier that can be manually assigned or generated automatically during object creation. This
identifier cannot be altered after the object has been persisted.

version.description:
Version number used for optimistic concurrency.  Automatically managed by the system.

Updating an Obj with a null or 0 value for version will cause the concurrency check to be skipped and should only
be done with great caution.

typeWithBindings.description: Persists concrete type with bindings for generic types where instance has parameter bindings

fileStats.description:
This field stores basic statistics about data quality across all the raw data
{@link File}s available.

canonicalPointMeasurementStats.description:
This field stores basic statistics about data quality across all
{@link CanonicalPointMeasurement} {@link File}s available.

canonicalPointPhysicalMeasurementSeriesS.description:
This field stores basic statistics about data quality across all
{@link CanonicalPointPhysicalMeasurementSeries} {@link File}s available.

canonicalReliabilityAssetEventStats.description:
This field stores basic statistics about data quality across all
{@link CanonicalReliabilityAssetEvent} {@link File}s available.

assetHierarchyExcelStats.description:
This field stores basic statistics about data quality across all
asset hierarchy spreadsheet {@link File}s available.

errors.description:
If there are errors discovered while cross-checking data of different
{@link ReliabilityRawDataValidationDataType}s, they will be reported in this field.
Errors are mandatory to rectify.

warnings.description:
If there are warnings discovered while cross-checking data of different
{@link ReliabilityRawDataValidationDataType}s, they will be reported in this field.
Warnings are not mandatory to rectify.

stats.description:
The overall picture of data quality is stored as a json {@link File} in the {@link stats}
field. This json {@link File} is available for consumption by the end user. However, it is encouraged
to use one of the helper functions on this Type to get a user-friendly output of the most
commonly required overviews of data quality.

job.description:
It is highly recommended that the raw data validation be executed as a distributed
{@link ReliabilityRawDataValidationJob}. In the case that this report is generated by the job,
the reference to the job will be stored in the {@link job} field.

title:
This is the report of data quality across all the raw source data {@link File}s
available. While {@link ReliabilityRawDataValidationFileReport} contains the report of
a single {@link File} of one {@link ReliabilityRawDataValidationDataType}, this report contains
cross-checked data quality reports of all {@link File}s across all available
{@link ReliabilityRawDataValidationDataType}s.
name: ReliabilityRawDataValidationReport
